newsitem.title: USA: Seagull Energy completes 2nd Vidor well.
newsitem.headline: Seagull Energy completes 2nd Vidor well.

text.p: Seagull Energy Corp said it completed a second well at its Anderson Gully prospect located onshore in the city of Vidor in Orange County, Texas, about 100 miles east of Houston.

Seagull said the Vastar Fee No. 2 well was drilled to nearly 14,500 feet and tested a Yegua sand for 3.2 million cubic feet of natural gas and 120 barrels of condensate per day through a 9/64-inch choke with flowing tubing pressure of 7,602 pounds per square inch. Tests of the same zone in the No. 1 well in mid-1996 yielded 3.3 million cubic feet of natural gas and 77 barrels of condensate per day.

Design and permitting of production facilities and pipelines is underway, with initial production from the two discoveries anticipated in mid-1997, Seagull said. Additional wells will be considered after production is established.
Seagull said it holds a 75 percent working interest and is operator of the discoveries. The remaining interests are held by Venus Exploration Inc of San Antonio and another private firm.
